Proposition
[Detecting Smoothness by Local Diffeomorphisms]

1. ch4:4.10Let $M,N,P$ be smooth manifolds with or without boundary and let $F:M\to N$ be a local diffeomorphism. If $G:P\to M$ is continuous, then $G$ is smooth if and only if $F\circ G$ is smooth. If $F$ is also surjective and $G:N\to P$ is any map, then $G$ is smooth if and only if $G\circ F$ is smooth.
